item.title: Jackson Police Department releases 2025 annual report
item.description: JACKSON, Mo., (KBSI) — The Jackson Police Department has released its 2025 Annual Report, outlining department activity, statistics, community programs and major accomplishments from the past year. According to the report, officers responded to 20,825 calls for service, conducted 4,594 traffic stops and made 386 arrests in 2025. Police also investigated 316 motor vehicle crashes, including 70 crashes with injuries....

item.description: BOONE COUNTY, Mo. (KBSI) — Firefighters with the Boone County Fire Protection District rescued a cat that became stuck high in a tree Thursday morning. item.title: Area students compete in Southeast Missouri Job Olympics in Jackson
item.description: JACKSON, Mo. (KBSI) — High school students from across southeast Missouri gathered Friday at the Jackson Civic Center to compete in the Southeast Missouri Job Olympics.
